title: speq environment v1
description: One file in the environments directory, selected with --env. Read by read_env_vars in speq-cli/src/cli/run.rs, which treats 'baseUrl' specially and turns every other top-level key into a variable of the same name. This schema is therefore open, unlike the other .speq schemas.

baseUrl.description: Prefix for relative step URLs. Also exposed as the variable {{baseUrl}}. Defaults to an empty string, which requires every step to use an absolute URL.

name.description: Conventional label for the environment. The CLI does not read it — like any other key it simply becomes the variable {{name}}. The environment is selected by filename, not by this field.

headers.description: By convention, headers to send with every request — but the CLI does NOT apply them. Only a step's own 'headers' block reaches the request; this key becomes the variable {{headers}} like any other. See speq-tms/speq-docs#21.

additionalProperties.description: Any other key becomes a variable of that name, referenced as {{key}}. Values may be any JSON value.
